title: Noise sensitivity and total influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $0\leq\delta\leq1$. Choose $X$ uniformly from the sign cube and obtain $Y$ by independently, in each coordinate, keeping the sign of $X$ with probability $1-\delta$ and flipping it with probability $\delta$. The probability that $f(X)\neq f(Y)$ is at most $\delta$ times the total influence of $f$, where the influence in each coordinate is the uniform expectation of the squared discrete derivative of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs
